scope: Representative real production-E/lift arrivals on garden/pool/penthouse source-world roofs. Space edges drive the actual player, including held-input arrival, six fresh presses above the former nine-metre region ceiling, landing and hold/menu gates. Articulated limb/shoe meshes and joints are observed independently during actual physical displacement, wall blocking, air and paused/facility ownership. Scenario-start teleports and wall/control fixtures are explicit. Native normal-camera PNGs only outside headless. Original city collision and player capsule retained. No all-angle camera, measured human gait, full catalogue roof activity, performance, fluid simulation or human OS input acceptance.
